rule: README and SKILL.md derive their claims from this file. ADVISORY must never be described as ENFORCED. Every ENFORCED entry cites automated tests (tests/<file>.py#<test-id>); a claim without executable evidence is downgraded.

state_machine.evidence: scripts/contribution_session.py: linear gates, objective machine evidence only, illegal transitions exit 1

permissions.evidence: session authority gates: PATCH requires granted worktree_edit; grants require --by-user + --evidence-ref

remote_write_control.evidence: no session-wide remote_write flag exists; remote actions are one-shot scoped grants (action/target/authorized_by/evidence_ref/created_at/consumed_at); upstream observation grants nothing

source_read_provenance.evidence: cognition_receipt record-read binds sha256 per read; verify flags CURRENT/CHANGED/DELETED

context_budget.evidence: budget_governor govern (public CLI): bounded pack->audit->prune->repack->ACCEPT/BLOCKED; accounting recomputed from actual spans; pack_digest regenerated after pruning

retrieval_routing.evidence: ROUTING_POLICIES per workflow; --signals override recorded as ablation; priors validated via ROUTING REGRET, not assumed

no_regret_packing.evidence: direct-first ordering + structural share cap (constructive); pack.no_regret.displaced_direct reporting

evidence_witnessing.evidence: results exist only via evidence_manifest record (exit-code witnessed, sha256 artifacts) or explicit record-skip with reason; gates read typed evidence, not purpose strings

stale_validation_blocking.evidence: head-bound records at another HEAD block CONTRIBUTOR_UNDERSTANDING and PR_READY; RED is bound to the pre-patch base SHA and production edits before PATCH are refused

red_green_regression_identity.evidence: RED_REGRESSION requires regression_id AND test-file digests; GREEN must match both; a changed test invalidates the RED proof

structured_artifact_gates.evidence: recon/dedupe/scope-audit artifacts must be typed, digest-bound JSON with full envelope; {} or tampered files are rejected

duplicate_work_check.evidence: duplicate_work_scan collects evidence but nothing mechanically proves the agent ran the scan before PROVE

contributor_understanding.evidence: UNDERSTOOD requires --confirmed-by (human); DEFERRED/INCOMPLETE cannot reach IN_REVIEW. Whether the human truly understands remains human judgment

upstream_lifecycle.evidence: upstream_state classify(): MERGED is the only success; capture is marked UPSTREAM_OBSERVED and grants nothing

security_stop.evidence: SKILL.md hard rule 9 + recon SECURITY.md step; no mechanical detector of security findings

aoci_file_compatibility.evidence: retrieval_router parses aoci.*.txt FRAS volumes read-only with sampled baseline alignment check; degrades to unverified honestly

aoci_runtime_integration.evidence: no MCP/CLI calls to an AOCI runtime (rules/overview/search/get-entries); the file parser is the fallback path and is named AOCI_FILE

graph_source_test_relations.evidence: naming conventions + import scan -> production<->test edges

graph_pagerank_prior.evidence: power-iteration PageRank with query personalization (repomap signal)

graph_calls_references_inheritance.evidence: no call/reference/inheritance edges are produced; prefer LSP/SCIP/Serena adapters over more regex

embedding_retrieval.evidence: deliberate: no model dependency; pluggable arm documented, never filled to complete an ablation table

artifact_task_binding.evidence: artifacts bound to session repository identity + base revision (+task/goal when present)

remote_action_causality.evidence: IN_REVIEW requires an OPEN_PR action receipt bound to a prior grant; target must match the captured upstream identity

artifact_integrity.evidence: goal contract verified at init via digest recomputation; artifact digests checked before applicability

dedupe_evidence_provenance.evidence: GOOD_CANDIDATE requires a recorded dedupe bundle; parse-search results fold into the SAME DUPLICATE_WORK_EVIDENCE bundle (keyword_issue_search / keyword_pr_search, repository_id + capture timestamp + digest); provenance persisted in classification_evidence

upstream_review_lifecycle.evidence: CHANGES_REQUESTED -> accept-review-change -> PATCH with revalidation debt -> request-rereview (grant+receipt+fresh validation) -> READY_FOR_REREVIEW; terminal outcomes via classifier

pre_publication_state_machine.evidence: linear pre-publication gates (DISCOVER..PR_READY) mechanically refuse out-of-order or evidence-less transitions

red_green_test_identity.evidence: RED without test identity refused; GREEN must match regression_id and test digests

validation_attempt_semantics.evidence: FAIL superseded only by a later same-type PASS; history stays visible; UNAVAILABLE never becomes PASS

rules_read_receipt.evidence: CANDIDATE gate auto-discovers binding docs (AI instructions + governance docs) and requires a RULES_READ receipt whose covered digests match current files; changed docs force re-read

complexity_delta_visibility.evidence: diff_scope_check --show-delta/--show-hats surfaces new symbols/branches/flags/imports per production file; two-hats classification (TEST/MECHANICAL/declared) verified

representation_first_review.evidence: Representation-First lens (STATE/DATA/OWNERSHIP/RELATIONSHIPS/INVARIANTS/SPECIAL CASES) encoded in references/code-review.md for design-sensitive patches; deliberately not a blocking gate

two_hats_separation.evidence: Two Hats doctrine + per-file hat classification in diff_scope_check; mixing unrelated refactor into a bug fix is flagged for review, not auto-blocked

doctrine_freeze.evidence: doctrine represented as engineering lenses; frozen V5.3 — new quotations only when exposing a missing rule
